message.jaymoskingdoms.sky_cove.cleared: The sky pirate captain of %s has fallen to %s! The eyrie's pirates scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.sky_cove.thanks: Word of the sky captain's death spreads under the clouds: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
book.jaymoskingdoms.sky_wreck.page1:
The %s, out of %s, bound for %s.

Boilers fired, bag full, a fair wind behind us.
book.jaymoskingdoms.sky_wreck.page2:
Second day. %s lies %s of us, %s.

The wind is backing and rising. The glass is falling.
book.jaymoskingdoms.sky_wreck.page3: The bag is torn along the seam and we cannot hold her up. The ground is coming up. Whoever finds this, we did what we could.
